verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents dynamic transactional templates that support multiple versions [sendgrid-docs-10, sendgrid-docs-27, sendgrid-docs-12]. It also offers a v3 Mail Send API [sendgrid-docs-15, sendgrid-docs-2]. However, the template-versioning doc sits under the UI section, and nothing in the pack shows templates being created, versioned, or updated through the API, or a send referencing a template id with a variable payload. missing for 10: evidence of template create/update/version endpoints in the API, evidence of Mail Send accepting a template id with dynamic variable data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
